thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Elevated SRV lookup failures from internal service discovery (consul + CoreDNS) observed in us-west-2a. Error rate spike > 40% for _svc._tcp.* lookups. Pager: maria (oncall).

maria: saw the alert, looking now. any customer-facing impact?

jin: not seeing frontend 5xxs in prod apis. service mesh health looks ok, but background jobs hitting internal services are failing name resolution.

maria: good. initial triage — seems localized to AZ us-west-2a. SRV queries to the local CoreDNS endpoints time out.

tom: reproducing: from a host in us-west-2a: `dig +short SRV _api._tcp.service.internal @10.0.1.2` -> returns nothing, then `dig +short SRV ... @10.0.2.3` (us-west-2b) -> healthy.

lee: consul health shows leader churn around 2026-03-14T21:10Z in us-west-2a. some agents reported connection timeouts.

eng-network: we’re seeing BGP flap alerts for the AZ spine in us-west-2a between 21:08Z-21:12Z. could be packet loss affecting UDP DNS.

maria: ok plan: 1) switch traffic for critical internal clients to cross-AZ resolvers as short-term mitigation; 2) scale CoreDNS replicas in us-west-2a to restore capacity; 3) collect `tcpdump`/`strace` on a failing CoreDNS pod; 4) coordinate with cloud network ops for fabric issue.

jin: starting runbook step: scale coredns replicas: `kubectl -n kube-system scale deployment coredns --replicas=6 --context=cluster-prod-usw2a`

deploy-bot: deployment.apps/coredns scaled to 6

maria: also lowering DNS client retry backoff on affected services to 2s so retries surface faster (temporary).

tom: adding iptables rule workaround to forward queries to cross-AZ resolvers: `iptables -t nat -A OUTPUT -p udp --dport 53 -j DNAT --to-destination 10.0.2.3:53` — applied to a handful of test hosts only.

lee: captured example failure logs from a CoreDNS pod: 
```
2026-03-14T21:09:52Z [ERROR] plugin/forward: dialing failed to upstream 10.0.1.2:53: read udp 10.0.1.5:45321->10.0.1.2:53: i/o timeout
2026-03-14T21:10:03Z [WARN] health: plugin reload took 120ms
```

jin: tcpdump on node shows high UDP packet retransmit and ICMP unreachable from local resolver IPs — points to network fabric packet loss rather than coredns process crash.

eng-network: confirmed, open ticket with cloud provider for spine fabric in us-west-2a. we've escalated to SE.

sara: customer-impact update for support: affected workloads are internal batch processors and some async ingestion pipelines. No direct product timeouts for interactive users observed. Logging ingestion for a subset in us-west-2a delayed ~10-40m.

maria: marking incident severity = P2 (internal service discovery degradation, partial AZ impact). Notifying customer success for any enterprise customers with pinned us-west-2a Dedicated nodes.

tom: mitigation note: scaled up CoreDNS and added cross-AZ forwarding plus iptables tests — resolution trend: error rate dropped from 42% -> 6% over 18 minutes.

deploy-bot: scaled deployment "coredns" from 3 to 6 replicas in cluster-prod-usw2a by jin

lee: also forced consul leader election in us-west-2a to clear stale state: `consul operator raft remove-peer` (performed with care). Leader stabilized on node consul-2-usw2b.

jin: rolling restart of CoreDNS pods in us-west-2a to rebind sockets: `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/coredns` — completed without image change.

maria: handing over to eng-network for cloud provider follow-up and post-incident analysis. @tom you're primary. I'll monitor for 30m and then close if stable.

eng-network: taking handoff. cloud ticket 987654 opened with provider (referencing BGP/flap window). collecting pcap and AMI-level metrics.

sara: note for CS: flagged 3 enterprise customers with Dedicated capacity in us-west-2a; outreach drafted in #customer-success, awaiting approval.

maria: current status: error rate ~4.8% in us-west-2a, most services resolved via cross-AZ resolvers. no active pages for user-facing APIs.

lee: logging: we should add more metrics around per-AZ UDP loss for DNS and an alert for SRV success rate dropping below 90% per AZ. filing GH issue: infra/observability#1421

jin: adding defensive change to kube-dns config: lower upstream timeout from 5s -> 2s and enable upstream fallback to other AZs sooner. will PR to infra-configs repo.

eng-network: cloud provider responded: noisy neighbor ECMP convergence impacted some spine leaf routes in us-west-2a for ~4 minutes; they applied control-plane fixes. Provider marks as root cause.

maria: closing steps: 1) follow-up ticket for runbook update (shorten SRV detection window); 2) observability alert improvements (lee); 3) confirm Dedicated customer outreach (sara); 4) postmortem assignment (maria tom jin).

sara: outreach sent to the 3 customers, cc leadership. template used, logged in support-ticketing.

maria: thanks all. leaving incident channel to eng-network. If errors reappear, page oncall as usual. :white_check_mark:
